Definition: comparative of G4705; more prompt, more earnest:--more diligent (forward).
BiblicalUsage: The word is the comparative, more forward: Titus accepted the exhortation, but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto the Corinthians. The zeal was his own, not forced on him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the more forward man is the one who goes because he wants to, and Titus went to Corinth on his own accord.
